body: Audit docs/tasks/AUDIT-BUILT-2026-11-05.md: B-5 the Encore API calls carry the music-server token (md5 of password and salt) in the address; this item is the fix. B-10/B-18/B-19 are about the same sign-in code: signing in takes the database write lock on every request (measured with 20 phones), and a new person's first request asks the music server inside that lock.
